echoParts: I have been crucified with Christ
verseText: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.
meaning: When we believe in Jesus, we share in his death and life. His death on a cross was our death for our sins. And his new life on the third day means our forever life in his kingdom.

recall.question: Who does Paul say lives in him?

meaning.question: What happens when we belong to Christ?

application.prompt: Think of one choice today where you can remember that Christ lives in you and choose what pleases Him.
